mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MOMENT (USER_ID, CONTENT_ID, YOUTUBE_ID, START_TIME, END_TIME, MEMO) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contentId}, #{youtubeId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{memo,jdbcType=CLOB})
mapper.select: SELECT MOMENT_ID, USER_ID, CONTENT_ID, YOUTUBE_ID, START_TIME, END_TIME, MEMO, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM MOMENT WHERE MOMENT_ID = #{momentId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{value}
SELECT MOMENT_ID, USER_ID, CONTENT_ID, YOUTUBE_ID, START_TIME, END_TIME, MEMO, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM MOMENT WHERE MOMENT_ID = #{momentId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND DEL_YN = 'N' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE MOMENT SET START_TIME = #{startTime}, END_TIME = #{endTime}, MEMO = #{memo,jdbcType=CLOB}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE MOMENT_ID = #{momentId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE MOMENT SET DEL_YN = 'Y', DELETED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE MOMENT_ID = #{momentId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
